tests: Read-only reopen records a fully hashed discarded preparation.
Mutation records discarded bytes; dropping the mount still drains the replacement generation.
Mounted 20 MiB file hashes exactly 20 MiB and records no canceled bytes.
limitations: Counters observe existing behavior; this change does not optimize sealing.
Mutation classification includes namespace and metadata changes.
Preparation time is cumulative elapsed service time, not CPU time or added Cargo latency.
Bytes count chunk identity hashing, not file/pack hashing or producer prefetch.
